> Used by `.github/workflows/reassess.yml` (weekly, or every 10 merges to `main`).
> The workflow fills in the auto-collected metrics; a human or agent answers the
> judgment sections, updates `docs/strategy/COMPASS.md`, drops a dated snapshot in
> `docs/strategy/reassessments/`, and posts the verdict + course-corrections as a
> comment here. Keep it short — data via API, prose minimal.

## Metrics (auto-collected)
- Stars: ___ · Forks: ___ · Open issues: ___
- Traffic (views / unique / clones): ___
- Commits to `main` since last reassessment: ___

## Origin arc / WHY still true?
- [ ] The objective (SPEC-northstar §) still describes what we are building.
- [ ] No silent pivot since last cycle (anti-pivot contract holds).

## New research / findings / what's been MISSED
-

## Third-person product outlook
- **Human user view:** is there anything a user can run / see / experience?
- **AI-agent / contributor view:** can a new agent orient from `main` alone?

## Reach / visibility
- README / landing quality, discoverability, any rendered evidence?

## Evidence gates (SPEC §6)
- [ ] LATENCY: status ___
- [ ] ENERGY: status ___

- [ ] on-track  [ ] drifting  [ ] pivot
